name: pi-desktop
description: Pi Desktop — Electron + React + FastAPI AI coding agent

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:electron: cd electron && npm run build && NODE_ENV=development electron dist/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.package: npm run build && cd electron && npx electron-builder
scripts.postinstall: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../electron && npm install
